notablePrerequisites: You have at least two additional land cards in hand.
description:
Activate Secluded Steppe's cycling ability by paying {W} and discarding it.
 Surly Badgersaur's second ability triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Secluded Steppe ability, causing you to mill three cards and return Life from the Loam from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Borborygmos Enraged by discarding a land card.
Surly Badgersaur's second ability triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Borborygmos Enraged ability, dealing 3 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 4 one additional time.
Activate the three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{G}{W}.
Cast Life from the Loam by paying {1}{G}, returning Secluded Steppe and two other lands from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
